parameters.name: BusinessStatus
parameters.description:
The payment status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

*   **Normal**
*   **FinancialLocked**

parameters.name: GatewayType
parameters.description:
VPN 网关类型，取值：
Traditional：传统型VPN网关，覆盖IPsec功能和SSL功能
Enhance.SiteToSite：增强型站点入云VPN，只覆盖IPsec功能

parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return information about pending orders. Valid values:

*   **false** (default)
*   **true**

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPN gateway.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the VPN gateway belongs.

 You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query the resource group list.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

*   **init**
*   **provisioning**
*   **active**
*   **updating**
*   **deleting**

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that are added to the VPN gateway.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the VPN gateway belongs.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-gateways --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp1m3i0kn1nd4wiw90000 --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp17lofy9fd0dnvzv0000 --status active --business-status Normal --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --include-reservation-data true --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --gateway-type Enhanced.SiteToSite --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc DescribeVpnGateways --region cn-hangzhou --Status active --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --VpcId 'vpc-bp1m3i0kn1nd4wiw90000' --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzs372yg0000' --VpnGatewayId 'vpn-bp17lofy9fd0dnvzv0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --GatewayType 'Enhanced.SiteToSite' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --BusinessStatus Normal --IncludeReservationData true
